notes.title: Steam Remote Play | Gamepad Troubleshooting
notes.content:
If you're having problems with your gamepad, try turning off steam's gamepad override. Sometimes it does something to the gamepad making it not work as intended.

If you're having problems with the gamepad while using remote play. I recommend the remote play user, use the keyboard controls.

If you're having problems selecting a character because of controller drift, the directional keys work as well! (arrow buttons) 

Thanks for checking out Ooka Ooka Adventure!

Any problems or any feedback reach me on reachdaemin@gmail.com
